detail.title: Work | Andreas Tsang
heading: Recent Work
detail.mainText:
Recent Work
2026
PAST

RESEARCH AND IMPLEMENTATION

Hybrid Neural Heuristics for Faster Real-Time Path Planning

Connecticut Science and Engineering Fair finalist medallion, Mathematics

I tested whether learned spatial guidance could reduce search effort while preserving path quality in cluttered maps. The system pairs a U-Net corridor predictor with a learned costmap heuristic, then uses those outputs to narrow and guide A*.

A*
Dijkstra
U-Net
Neural heuristics
CSEF POSTER
Summer 2025
PAST

WOLFRAM SUMMER RESEARCH PROGRAM

Chaotic Mineral Flow Simulation for Deposition Analysis

Public Wolfram Community technical writeup

I modeled high-temperature mineral flow around obstacles with Navier-Stokes based functions, then turned the results into a 3D animated box and a 2D interactive interface for deposition analysis.

Navier-Stokes
Wolfram Language
CFD
